heading: INT. ROOFTOP HELIPAD, UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL - DAWN

units.text: INT. ROOFTOP HELIPAD, UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL - DAWN
Wind whips the windsock.
The city below is a quilt of pink and gray.
A helicopter idles on the pad, rotors turning slow.
Three staff stand by a wheeled cooler: DR. IMANI OKAFOR-REYES (40s, flight suit), NURSE ALARIC BRIGHTWATER-LUU (30s, backpack), and TRANSPLANT COORDINATOR SERAPHINA KOWALSKI-ASANTE (50s, headset).
The cooler contains a donor heart.
Okay. Last check. Cooler sealed? Ice good? Paperwork in?
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Sealed. Ice good. Paperwork in.
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Control, we are loaded. Requesting clearance.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Four minutes.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Four minutes. I can do four minutes.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: The rotors whine.
Alaric lifts the cooler's handle, lowers it, lifts it again.
Doctor, can I ask something?
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Go.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Is it supposed to feel this heavy?
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Yes.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Is it supposed to feel this light?
units.name: ALARIC

units.text: Also yes.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Clearance in thirty.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Then let's go.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: She steps toward the helicopter.
Alaric steps after her.
Seraphina pulls off her headset, takes a breath, and walks to the pad's edge.
She looks down at the waking city.
Then, quietly, to the empty air:
Thank you.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: The rotors speed up.
The sun clears the buildings.
And somewhere in the cooler, nothing moves at all.
